blocks.text: JC Santos explores the dangers faced by human rights advocates in the upcoming biographical film “Romano,” which tells the story of Redemptorist priest Fr. Rosaleo “Rudy” Romano, who was abducted in Cebu in 1985 and remains missing to this day. Santos said it is important to tell Father Rudy’s story, which goes beyond his disappearance by highlighting his vocation, faith and dedication to serving others. “Mahalagang ipalabas ang pelikulang ito. Of course, sa pag-alala natin sa pagkawala ni Father Rudy, it’s also a story about family. It’s about vocation,” he said during a press conference on Wednesday, Nov. 18, at Baclaran […]...
